description:
Canonical schema for the MxAgile Artifact Index. Built deterministically from canonical YAML artifacts by build_artifact_index.py. Source of truth for cross-artifact relationship traversal, impact analysis, and lifecycle re-sync. This index is derived and rebuildable — canonical YAML artifacts are always authoritative.

Provenance terminology: DECLARED (deterministic from explicit YAML ref fields, highest authority), DERIVED (observed in artifacts not via dedicated ref fields), INFERRED (semantic/provider suggestion, lowest authority). Precedence: DECLARED > DERIVED > INFERRED.

nodes.description: All indexed canonical artifacts. Each node represents one artifact file.

edges.description: All cross-artifact relationships. Edges are directed (from -> to). Type encodes semantic relationship. Provenance encodes how the relationship was established.

source_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of all indexed source files at build time. Consumers compare against current files to detect staleness.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this index was built.

id.description: Stable artifact identifier matching the canonical ID field or filename stem. Examples: REQ-001, SPEC-002, PAGE-CALENDAR, TC-001, FLOW-ORDER-SUBMIT.

type.description: Artifact type. Determines which canonical path and schema apply.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the artifact file, forward-slashes.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact file content. Null when artifact is synthetic (e.g. design-contract-extracted flow).

status.description: Index staleness marker. Set by propagate_stale.py. Not the artifact's own lifecycle status.

display_name.description: Human-readable label for tooling and reports.

content.description: Full parsed artifact content for in-process consumers. Omitted in lightweight index variants.

type.description: Semantic relationship type. See edge-types section in docs/schemas.md for full semantics.

provenance.description: How this edge was established. DECLARED edges are authoritative; DERIVED and INFERRED are supplemental.

type.description: DECLARED: derived deterministically from an explicit canonical YAML ref field (equivalent to CANONICAL in policy docs). DERIVED: observed in artifact text/content outside dedicated ref fields (equivalent to EXTRACTED). INFERRED: semantic/provider suggestion. Precedence: DECLARED > DERIVED > INFERRED.

source.description: The canonical field name or file path where this relationship was found. Examples: 'requirement.derivedFrom', 'spec.requirements[]', 'planning/test-contracts/TC-001.yaml'.
